text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: —Ahahaha! That's so unreal~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled by the sudden burst of laughter, I looked over to see...
Tosen Jordan laughing hysterically at a smartphone with her friend.

text_block_list.name: Jordan's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Jordan, check this one out too!
Isn't this insane?!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...No way! Pffft, holy crap,
my stomach hurts... Ahahaha, that's so dumb~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I didn't quite get it, but it looked entertaining. Intrigued, I figured
I'd ask her about it during our meeting, but—

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—I'm, like, teeeelling you.
It's California Toizumi!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
He does these totally stupid gags, and he's,
like, blowing up on UmaTok right now.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Y'know... "Waranouchi Ukemaro~"!
...Never heard of it?!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, then—then what about this one?
...*snicker*, heheh...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Hoppin' Panpopiin"!!
Ugh, that's so cringe, don't make me do it~! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Bruh.
Don't leave me hanging like that!

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
You don't know that one either? Like, seriously,
do you just not look at social media at all?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Well, I guess it is super new. What if it's not a gag, will you get it then?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
How about something like this, then?
~♪

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Or, like, this one~
Isn't this, like, super cute?~♪

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, yeah, but that's totally missing the point~!
Man, you really don't know anything, do you?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if you don't even know UmaTok,
what do you usually watch? What actually makes you laugh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking about it, I've been so busy lately that I haven't kept up with
any entertainment trends. So, I could only offer a generic answer.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, gotcha. I don't really watch TV, honestly.
I might barely recognize a show or comedian, though. Hit me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, nothing came to mind right away, so I brought up the name of a
show I remembered watching as a kid called "Laughing Derby," but...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Never heard of it~. Besides, there's no way I'd know
something from that long ago. Is it on UmaTube?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Actually... this kinda feels like
talking to my parents.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, we're done with the meeting, right?
I'm gonna head out. Later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The worlds we live in are just way too different...
At this rate, I might never understand her, and our conversations will keep missing each other completely.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I wanted to know what she liked—so I started following the comedians she mentioned earlier, along with other trending UmaTokkers.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And after endless research and practice—a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up?
...Why do you look so intense? Whoa, kinda creepy. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Making sure she's watching, I take a deep breath.
Recalling the videos I watched over and over—

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Gotta film this first.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So like, how old are those bits even?
Haven't seen those in foreeever.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
California Fujiizumi is ancient history, dude.
Everyone's into "Michael lu Michaele" now. Never heard of 'em?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Really? But like, what brought this on all of a sudden~?
You totally ignored me when I cracked a joke earlier.
choice_data_list: I thought it would make you laugh.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...You went outta your way to study up on that?
Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Total flop, though~.
Alright, do-over. I'm posting this to UmaTok, so give it your all~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems closing the gap between me and Toosen Jordan
is going to require a lot more effort.
